skill.description: 当用户需要做 B站评论分析、B站评论洞察、B站用户反馈分析、B站需求挖掘、痛点总结、购买顾虑整理、FAQ 提炼、口碑分析、评论回复观察或内容讨论复盘时使用。基于用户提供的 B站视频、专栏、动态链接或对应内容 ID 下的评论结果，面向内容运营、产品调研、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Analyze Bilibili comments and replies to identify feedback themes, unmet needs, purchase concerns, and practical next steps.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts reflect Markdown syntax, legitimate credential configuration, documentation links, content identifiers, or readable Chinese text. The CLI examples automatically execute an unpinned npm package, creating supply-chain exposure in an environment containing the API key. No evidence found of malicious instructions or credential theft in these files; the external package implementation was unavailable for review.

remediation.issue: CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a fixed package version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package integrity, and obtain execution consent before installation. Limit available credentials to the required service key.

content.user_title: Analyze Bilibili Comments and Audience Needs
content.value_statement: Bilibili comment threads can make recurring questions and audience concerns difficult to identify. This skill guides comment retrieval and organizes visible feedback into evidence-based findings.
actual_capabilities: Guide comment retrieval from Bilibili videos, articles, and dynamic posts using content IDs, URLs, short links, or share text.
Retrieve reply threads using comment object identifiers and a parent comment ID.
Control retrieval with page counts, item limits, pagination tokens, and supported sorting options.
Organize visible comments into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, FAQs, and recommendations.
Separate quoted comment evidence from interpretation and disclose sample coverage.
Preserve partial results and resume pagination using returned tokens while respecting original collection limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance; CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.
Includes instructions and agent configuration, not the external CLI implementation; package behavior cannot be verified from these files.
Findings cover only returned comments and replies, not all Bilibili users or platform-wide opinion.
Provides a documented read-only workflow without login, posting, likes, comment submission, or account changes.

use_cases.title: Plan Follow-Up Content
use_cases.description: Review a creator's video comments to identify recurring questions and propose topics supported by visible feedback.

use_cases.title: Investigate Product Concerns
use_cases.description: Group comments on relevant product videos into pain points, buying concerns, and unmet needs with supporting quotations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer FAQs
use_cases.description: Summarize questions and reply-thread context into a prioritized FAQ and response checklist without posting to Bilibili.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Comment Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first comment page for [Bilibili URL]. List recurring themes and visible quotes, and state that this is a partial sample.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Buying Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 100 comments for [content ID]. Separate purchase concerns, unmet needs, and suggested actions, with visible evidence for each.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Reply Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch replies for [comment object ID], [object type], and [comment ID], limited to two pages. Separate participant statements from your interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [Bilibili URL] for [research question], capped at three pages and 200 comments. Report themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, FAQs, quotes, actions, and coverage. Preserve partial results and resume only with returned tokens within remaining limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: produce a bounded research report

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: comments ask whether a device works with older phones and where to find setup instructions.
output: Purchase concern: Support for older phones is unclear.
FAQ candidates: Which phones are supported? Where are the setup instructions?
Action: Publish a compatibility checklist and a setup guide.
Coverage: This illustration reflects only the supplied sample.

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: the comment says 'Please show the battery test,' and replies request a longer demonstration.
output: Interpretation: The discussion suggests interest in more detailed testing.
Content action: Prepare a longer battery demonstration.
Boundary: This thread does not establish platform-wide demand.

best_practices: Define the target content, research question, page limit, and item limit before making API requests.
Keep credentials in the required environment variable and review a pinned CLI version before authorizing execution.
Separate quotations from interpretation, disclose coverage, and preserve partial results when continuing pagination.
anti_patterns: Treating a first-page sample as representative of all Bilibili users.
Using unlimited pagination without an agreed collection scope or service budget.
Inventing comment quotations or rewriting pagination tokens to resume collection.

faq.question: Which Bilibili inputs are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow accepts video, article, and dynamic-post links or content IDs. The URL entry also supports short links and share text.

faq.question: What setup does the skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network access. Direct CLI use needs Node.js and npm; existing MCP tools are an alternative.

faq.question: Does using the skill consume service credits?
faq.answer: The workflow uses SocialDataX and documents insufficient-balance errors. Check current provider pricing and balance before collecting multiple pages.

faq.question: Can it post replies or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes. The external CLI implementation is not included.

faq.question: How should partial results be handled?
faq.answer: Keep returned items and errors. Resume with a nonempty next-page token and the remaining limits, rather than restarting from the first page.

faq.question: Are the results representative of all Bilibili users?
faq.answer: No. Findings reflect returned comments and replies for the selected content. Report the sample size, sorting, and retrieval coverage.
